name: Son Granot
description: The red Georgian house from the 18th century above Es Castell, with eight rooms and one of the island's noblest views: the mouth of Maó harbour with La Mola across the water. Gardens with dry-stone walls raised on old British defences, a kitchen garden feeding its restaurant, and the sea 500 metres away. Menorcan history with breakfast.

practicalInfo.acceso: Es Castell, at the entrance to Maó harbour.
practicalInfo.horario: Check the season and dates on the official website.
practicalInfo.servicios: 8 rooms (5 with sea views), pool and gardens, restaurant with its own kitchen garden.
